_doc: Day-level AI-search series pulled from Peec AI on 2026-08-31 via Executor. Replaces the weekly series in staging.json for the studies listed here. Each entry is a run of CONSECUTIVE days: `values[i]` is the value for `startDate + i` days, with no gaps. `metric` names the Peec column the series came from, and it MUST match the metric the study's existing published figures were computed from — verified against the stored weekly points on 2026-08-31: loudface and stealthFintech reconcile exactly against `visibility`, delshadLegal and genieTeacher against `share_of_voice`. Values are 0-1 ratios. Zeros are real: on those days no tracked AI answer named the brand.

excluded.genieTeacher: Peec tracking was paused 1 Jun - 13 Jul 2026, so only 29 days exist across a 3-month span. Equal-width daily bars would silently compress a 52-day gap into one bar width, which misstates the timeline. Stays on its weekly series, which labels the gap in its caption.
excluded.trademomentum: No Peec project. Its weekly series is hand-authored in src/app/(site)/dev-preview/trademomentum/data.ts and there is no API to repull it from.
